about: The ontology of this site's story graph (data/graph.json), in the shape the estate's newsroom ontologies use (portugal-ontology, governance-beat-ontology on newsroom.sgit.ai). The grammar is the estate's (graphs.sgit.ai/v1/grammar/): every edge is a verb with a different, named inverse; no generic association edge; no self-inverse edge, so a tension between claims is a node that flags them; supersede, never delete; weight by independence, not by count. Each verb says whether it is inherited from an estate ontology or proposed here. The build refuses an edge whose verb is not listed, and a node whose kind is not listed.
language_rule: A path reads as an English sentence: 'Wiz states claim X', 'claim X cites source Y', 'source Y is published by The Hacker News'.

node_types.label: Claim
node_types.definition: One sentence this site carries, with its sources and a status word (data/claims.json).

node_types.label: Number
node_types.definition: A figure someone published, with what it measures (data/numbers.json).

node_types.label: Event
node_types.definition: A dated moment on the timeline (data/timeline.json).

node_types.label: Exploitation signal
node_types.definition: One party's report of exploitation, attempts or none seen (data/exploitation.json).

node_types.label: Advice
node_types.definition: What one agency told operators to do, chiefly whether to take systems offline (data/agencies.json).

node_types.label: Tension
node_types.definition: A row of the fact-check desk's contradiction ledger: claims that measure differently, dispute or contradict each other. A node, because the grammar has no self-inverse edge.

node_types.label: Topic
node_types.definition: A class in the topic taxonomy of claims.

node_types.label: Phase
node_types.definition: A class in the phase taxonomy of the timeline.

node_types.label: Party
node_types.definition: A person, organisation, agency, outlet, group, registry, platform or project (data/entities.json); its class is in 'class'.

node_types.label: Source
node_types.definition: A page in the evidence vault's manifest (data/sources.json).

node_types.label: Capture
node_types.definition: One time the vault saved a source: its files and their hashes. The first fractal layer below a source.

node_types.label: CVE
node_types.definition: An anchor node: a CVE identifier, where the story graph joins the code-review graph (data/review.json) and the outside world (cve.org). It has no authority of its own.

taxonomy.label: Exploitation signal classes
taxonomy.note: data/exploitation.json has fourteen spellings of five classes; the map says which is which and the build refuses a spelling it does not know.

edges.note: The originator, from data/attribution.json. The newsroom review's change 10.

Passed on, not originated: where a row says so ('via The Hacker News'), or where the fact-check desk found the claim's words in a capture whose publisher is not an origin. A source that is only cited is evidence, never a relay: it may support or contradict. Ten relays of one statement are one origin (board 062, 'restates').
This site counted it from a captured file or a clone.

The page is another party's wire copy (Reuters, dpa, PA) carried by the outlet that publishes it, from data/attribution.json 'sources'. One wire story on ten sites is one statement: the reason this verb exists.
Only where the fact-check desk found the claim's words in that capture's text, with the file's sha256.
Read from the row's text: a CVE identifier it contains.
Only where a captured source names the role (a CEO, a researcher writing as the firm). The Portugal ontology bans works_at for speaker cards, which assert no employment; these do.

bridges.basis: the review graph's vulnerability layer has one node per CVE (cve-109618, cve-109619)
bridges.note: The fractal step: a CVE node in this graph opens the code-review graph, with its own ontology (flaws, remediation, code) and its own verbs, joined by this named bridge. Its verbs are listed below as their own scope, unchanged.

banned.why: a generic association edge says nothing; the estate bans it outright
say what the mention does: cites, names, states or relays
self-inverse; a contradiction is a node that flags both claims
self-inverse; recorded as a contradiction node with tension 'measures-differently'
self-inverse, and agreement is read from independent states edges, not asserted

formulas.reads: The number of distinct parties that state a claim, after a person is folded into the organisation they work for, a part into its whole, and a member into a group that speaks with one voice; 'unnamed' counts as none.
formulas.used_for: the spectrum of evidence: weight by independence, not by count (board 062)

formulas.reads: [Echo] := a claim with at least three relays and at most one independent origin.
formulas.used_for: ten outlets repeating one headline are one source

formulas.reads: [Unnamed-origin claim] := a claim stated only by 'unnamed'.
formulas.used_for: a gap, not a party: the fact-check desk's weak signal

formulas.reads: [Under tension] := a claim flagged by a contradiction whose status is open.
formulas.used_for: the reading that pulls a claim down until explained
